slides.sub: A practical Hora template for calls and deep work.

slides.body: A Hora is a planetary hour, roughly an hour counted from sunrise. Exact length varies with day length. The day lord's Hora comes first.
After the day lord, Horas follow a fixed sequence: Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, then repeat.
Mercury (Budha) governs speech, numbers and negotiation. Traditionally a good fit for calls, proposals and contract reviews.
Saturn (Shani) governs discipline and structure. A fit for audits, backlog and long, repetitive deep work, less so for charm-heavy persuasion.

points: Pick one Mercury Hora a day for your key call
Block one Saturn Hora for deep work
Keep a Jupiter Hora for mentors and planning
Look up your own city's times; they shift daily

slides.body: Hora is a traditional timing aid, not a guarantee. Preparation beats any hour. Treat it as a two-week experiment and note what you see.
